execution: Actual installed CRAN mgcv 1.9-4, with unmodified source family algebra. Normal tests use committed static captures and require no R. Numerical inputs are frozen JSON, not regenerated at test time.
scope: Four-predictor identity/logeb/identity/identity links, positive scale bound b and phiPen ridge. Analytic derivatives through fourth order, source-link derivatives, penalized/unscaled initialization, fixed/Newton-selected/EFS fits, conditional covariance, EDF, criterion, AIC/logLik, fitted/prediction/SE, source residuals/quantile/CDF and public natural parameters/median/components/persistence.
boundaries: shash fitting ll includes per-observation -phiPen*phi^2; normalized public density omits this ridge.
Source residual centering contains an epsilon-independent Bessel expression, not the conditional mean; public point prediction uses source qf(0.5), the conditional median.

Source .log1pexp leaves -Inf unchanged under .bincode, producing positive-infinite ll at an exact zero standardized residual. An explicit anomaly fixture records this. Source residual/Rd density instead uses log1p(z^2) and remains finite.
Nonzero offsets are rejected by the source family.
